items.title: Realme Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition debut in India with 50dB ANC
items.summary: Realme launched the Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition in India on September 21 at Rs. 6,999, a themed reskin of the standard TWS earbuds with a Hogwarts-crest case and leather-finish design. It keeps 12.4mm drivers, Hi-Res Wireless audio, LHDC 5.0, up to 50dB hybrid ANC, Bluetooth 6.1 and 56 hours of total battery life, with sales starting September 22.

items.title: Bose doubles down on open-ear audio with Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen and Sport model
items.summary: Bose unveiled the Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen at $299 and the Sport Open Earbuds at $199 on September 19, both built on Bose OpenAudio technology with SpeechClarity AI voice isolation. The flagship Ultra Open adds a new driver with deeper bass, Cinema Mode with TrueSpatial, Snapdragon Sound with aptX Adaptive and up to 9 hours of playback, with an October 1 release.

items.title: Vivo Buds Clip launch with 42-hour battery life and real-time translation
items.summary: Vivo launched its first open-ear clip-on earbuds, the Buds Clip, in China on September 21 with up to 42 hours of combined battery life, spatial audio, AI call filtering and simultaneous connections to three devices. Each 5.2g earbud uses a flexible memory-titanium bridge and supports LDAC and Hi-Res Audio Wireless, positioning it as a rival to the Huawei FreeClip 2.

items.title: Oppo Enco X4 flagship earbuds pair Dynaudio tuning, adaptive ANC and 53-hour battery
items.summary: Oppo introduced the Enco X4 flagship true wireless earbuds alongside the Find X10 series on September 22, featuring a fourth-generation Dynaudio co-developed dual-driver system, a 6nm chip with adaptive ANC and lossless Hi-Res transmission. Each earbud adds AI live translation, IP55 protection and up to 53 hours of total battery life, launching first in China at CNY 1,199.

items.title: boAt Airdopes Prime 800D bring Google Gemini Crest AI to budget earbuds
items.summary: boAt launched the Airdopes Prime 800D in India on September 21 at Rs. 1,999, the first earbuds to feature its Crest AI platform built with Google Gemini. The TWS earbuds add Dolby Audio, 11mm drivers, Bluetooth 6.1 and up to 45 hours of playback, while Crest AI enables voice questions, Gmail or Calendar assistance and real-time translation across more than 25 languages.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 review: superb sound, but ANC trails Bose and Apple flagships
items.summary: A September 26 research-based review of the Sony WF-1000XM6 flagships praises class-leading transparency, best-in-class Android codec support including LDAC and Auracast, and a smaller shell that finally fits well, but finds noise cancellation slightly behind the Bose QuietComfort Ultra and AirPods Pro 3. Battery is rated at 8.5 hours with ANC on at moderate volume.

items.title: CMF Clip Pro open-ear earbuds launch with 10.8mm drivers, LDAC and Smart Dial case
items.summary: Nothing's sub-brand CMF launched the Clip Pro open-ear earbuds, a 5.9g clip-on design with a flexible titanium-core C-bridge, 10.8mm drivers, LDAC support and up to 32.5 hours of battery life with the case. Priced at $99 in the US and GBP 79 in the UK, the buds add a signature Smart Dial on the case for volume and playback control, IP54 protection and dual-device Bluetooth 5.4, with a global rollout after an August 15 debut.

items.title: Omdia: TWS shipments slip 0.7% in Q2 2026 as open-ear audio jumps 12%
items.summary: Omdia's Q2 2026 data shows global true wireless stereo shipments fell 0.7 percent year over year to 82.1 million units, the first annual decline since Q2 2023, while open wireless stereo grew 12 percent to 11.1 million units and lifted its share to 13.5 percent. Apple held the top spot with 20.5 percent share and OPPO was the only other top-five brand to grow, and Omdia forecasts OWS to nearly double to 90.5 million units by 2030.

items.title: Sonova announces Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 earbuds with replaceable battery
items.summary: Sonova announced the Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 on September 3, improving endurance to 12 hours per charge with a Qi wireless charging case and adding Google Fast Pair, Microsoft Swift Pair and a selectable robust RF mode over Bluetooth 6 and Snapdragon Sound. The earbuds ship with a user-replaceable battery design and an MSRP of $299.95.

items.title: Sony LinkBuds Clip review: open-ear surprise with lovely vocals and a fit that needs patience
items.summary: A Hindustan Times verified review of the Sony LinkBuds Clip scores it 7.9 out of 10, praising clean vocals, detailed instrument separation and class-leading call clarity via a bone-conduction sensor, with 9 hours of playback and IPX4 protection. The open-ear C-bridge fit needs an adjustment period and bass lacks the punch of sealed earbuds, but comfort and awareness make it a strong clip-on option.
